tutorial.title: How to get Google AI Studio API Key
tutorial.step1: Go to Google AI Studio at aistudio.google.com
tutorial.step2: Sign in with your Google account.
tutorial.step3: Click on 'Get API key' in the left sidebar.
tutorial.step4: Click the 'Create API key' button and follow the prompts.
tutorial.step6: Open the Settings menu in this application and paste the key.
